# Card Monitoring

- [Get card history](https://developer.paylov.uz/subscribe/card-monitoring/get-card-history)

## Notes (extraction)

- Served only at `.html`; the extensionless URL redirects to a directory URL that returns 403. Not linked from the site navigation. EN, RU and UZ `.html` pages were compared: all contain the Card Monitoring heading and one Get card history link. RU translates the link label and targets `/ru/subscribe/card-monitoring/get-card-history`; UZ translates the label and targets `/uz/subscribe/card-monitoring/get-card-history`.
